readme: ShaderLab backgrounds for Portfolio carousel cards: a library, imported per card by id, not one per project. `backgrounds` lists every exported background: `file` is the art-layer image, `preset` the ShaderLab recipe it was rendered from, `shadowColor` its average colour for projects.ts, `project` the project it follows, `primary` true for the one its project ships. `projects` lists each project once, with `primary` and `backgrounds` (ids, primary first, then the alternates): a card asks for a project to get its primary, or for a variant index to get an alternate. Lookup by background id still works. Regenerated on every Export all. See ~/Projects/ShaderLab/handoff/README.md.
